properties.description: Built 2026-10-18 (item 2 of req:a-proof-can-state-a-contradiction-cases-suppositions-and-cited-theorems). `Inference.cases` names the case hypotheses; the step discharges them (add_inference refuses one not assumed beneath it). `Inference.cases_exhaustive` (node_ref) names the record saying the cases cover every possibility; add_inference refuses one naming no node and draws it as a premise of the step. The step's reading carries `cases` {cases, declared, exhaustive_by, truth, why}; it does not hold while nothing is declared or the record does not hold. Exhaustiveness is the record's word (taken as given: the owner's; a computed check through its kept record: a checker's; a step concluding it), never reflow2's judgement of the cases. loop_status counts `cases_not_declared_exhaustive`; each is a `reasoning_not_as_stated` gap. Trial shape: Arrow's group-contraction step (inf:lemma-6), which could only `discharges` its two cases.
properties.name: A proof-by-cases step names its cases and the record that declares them exhaustive, and holds only while that record holds
